queries: WITH invoice_stats AS (SELECT invoice_number, AVG(CAST(product_quantity AS REAL)) AS avg_quantity, (SUM(derived_product_cost) - SUM(derived_total_cost)) / NULLIF(SUM(derived_total_cost), 0) AS cost_ratio FROM Invoice_Line_Items GROUP BY invoice_number), overall AS (SELECT AVG(avg_quantity) AS avg_quantity FROM invoice_stats) SELECT s.invoice_number, s.avg_quantity, s.cost_ratio, s.avg_quantity - o.avg_quantity AS difference_above_overall_average FROM invoice_stats AS s CROSS JOIN overall AS o WHERE s.avg_quantity > o.avg_quantity ORDER BY (s.avg_quantity - o.avg_quantity) IS NULL, difference_above_overall_average DESC LIMIT 10

WITH invoice_averages AS (SELECT invoice_number, AVG(CAST(product_quantity AS DOUBLE PRECISION)) AS average_quantity, (SUM(derived_product_cost) - SUM(derived_total_cost)) / NULLIF(SUM(derived_total_cost), 0) AS cost_ratio FROM Invoice_Line_Items GROUP BY invoice_number), overall AS (SELECT AVG(average_quantity) AS overall_average FROM invoice_averages) SELECT i.invoice_number, i.average_quantity, i.cost_ratio, i.average_quantity - o.overall_average AS quantity_above_overall_average FROM invoice_averages AS i CROSS JOIN overall AS o WHERE i.average_quantity > o.overall_average ORDER BY CASE WHEN i.average_quantity - o.overall_average IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END, quantity_above_overall_average DESC LIMIT 10

WITH invoice_stats AS (SELECT invoice_number, AVG(CAST(product_quantity AS REAL)) AS average_quantity, 1.0 * (SUM(derived_product_cost) - SUM(derived_total_cost)) / NULLIF(SUM(derived_total_cost), 0) AS cost_ratio FROM Invoice_Line_Items GROUP BY invoice_number), overall AS (SELECT AVG(average_quantity) AS overall_average_quantity FROM invoice_stats) SELECT s.invoice_number, s.average_quantity, s.cost_ratio, s.average_quantity - o.overall_average_quantity AS quantity_difference FROM invoice_stats AS s CROSS JOIN overall AS o WHERE s.average_quantity > o.overall_average_quantity ORDER BY quantity_difference DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 10
